reviewNotes: Twenty-five fishing-quest completion and item-delivery request fragments were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, dialogue and newline markers, leading and trailing fragment spaces, dynamic item grammar, addresses and signatures, speaker-specific voice, punctuation, and natural concatenated Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.
